description: Implementation of an in-memory local data source for notes, including CRUD operations, synchronization markers, and soft deletion handling.

classes.name: InMemoryNotesLocalDataSource
classes.description: A local data source implementation that stores notes in memory using Dart HashMaps, providing methods for CRUD operations, soft delete, synchronization timestamps, and query methods.

methods.name: upsertNote
methods.description: Inserts or updates a note in the local in-memory store.

methods.name: upsertNotesInTransaction
methods.description: Inserts or updates multiple notes atomically.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID.

methods.name: getAllNonDeletedSorted
methods.description: Returns all non-deleted notes sorted by most recent update.

methods.name: getAllIncludingDeleted
methods.description: Returns all notes, including deleted ones, sorted by most recent update.

methods.name: getDirtyNotes
methods.description: Returns all notes marked as dirty.

methods.name: markDeleted
methods.description: Marks a note as deleted and dirty, updating its timestamp.

methods.name: markClean
methods.description: Marks a list of notes as clean (not dirty).

methods.name: purgeDeleted
methods.description: Removes deleted and non-dirty notes from the store.

methods.name: getLastSyncAt
methods.description: Retrieves the last synchronization timestamp for a given key.

methods.name: setLastSyncAt
methods.description: Sets the synchronization timestamp for a given key.
